description: This file defines the ResourceService class, which provides methods for managing resources via HTTP requests in an Angular application. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, uploading, updating, and deleting resources, as well as downloading resource data.

classes.name: ResourceService
classes.description: Angular service class for resource management, including CRUD operations and file uploads/downloads.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of resources, optionally filtered by resource type and subtype.

methods.name: getTenantResources
methods.description: Retrieves resources specific to a tenant.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Fetches a resource by its ID.

methods.name: getResourceInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves resource info by resource ID.

methods.name: getResourceInfo
methods.description: Gets resource info based on type, scope, and key.

methods.name: downloadResource
methods.description: Downloads resource data by resource ID.

methods.name: uploadResource
methods.description: Uploads a single resource with file data.

methods.name: deleteResource
methods.description: Deletes a resource by ID, with optional force.

methods.name: getResourcesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves resource info for multiple resource IDs.
